description: This Java class defines a specific exception, CollateralCannotBeDeletedException, used within the collateral management module of the Fineract project. It encapsulates reasons why a collateral object cannot be deleted, including an enum of possible reasons and a constructor that accepts these reasons along with an identifier.

classes.name: CollateralCannotBeDeletedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a collateral cannot be deleted, with specific reasons.

classes.name: CollateralCannotBeDeletedReason
classes.description: Enum listing reasons why the collateral cannot be deleted, with methods to get corresponding error messages and codes.

methods.name: CollateralCannotBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a reason and loan collateral ID, passing appropriate information to the superclass.

methods.name: errorMessage
methods.description: Returns a specific error message for the reason ingredient.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns a specific error code for the reason.
